item.title: Digitalisation News Brief — 2026-09-18
item.description:
1. [Tech News] Crusoe raises $3.9B to build massive data centers and small modular ‘AI factories’
The round values the data center giant at $30.9 billion.

2. [Tech News] Base Labs launches an open-weight AI safety partnership with Hugging Face and Goodfire
Base Labs, the research group Baseten spun up earlier this year, will develop and publish methods for training and monitoring open models.

3. [Tech News] Bose returns with new open earbuds (and a refreshed favorite)
Bose announces the Ultra Open (2nd Gen) and the Sport Open Earbuds, offering more options for aware listeners.

4. [Tech News] Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate
The new institute aims to surface differing views between Google, Google DeepMind, and the broader global research community around AGI. "They will not always agree, and they will likely change their minds, as more data and information comes to light at the fast-moving frontier."

5. [Tech News] Huawei plans Q1 2027 launch of new AI chip as it takes on Nvidia
Huawei is accelerating the launch of its next-generation Ascend 960DT AI chip as it pushes to compete with Nvidia and close China’s AI computing gap with the U.S.
